title: Fabulous 👌
text:
Great small group of couples & friend group attended when me & my husband where there, 8 in total so was perfect.

Manuel was a fabulous host / sailor. Keeping us all topped up with drinks, snacks & made to feel relaxed & safe. 
Also gave me a blanket when it got bit chilly out in the sea.

The saxophonist was fabulous, great range of songs & played any requests, kept us entertained for the duration.

Highly recommend.
author: S28NJchristinag

title: Fantastic experience
text:
What an amazing time we had on the sunset cruise our captain  was Manual who was absolutely fantastic, friendly, comical and calming (very choppy sea 🌊 on the way out) and Demal (sorry if that's not the correct name/spelling) the saxophone player who again was so friendly and up for a laugh and brilliant at distracting us from the choppy sea 🤣 

Our fellow boat trippers made for a great evening too.
author: JemJodds2015

title: Perfect start to our honeymoon
text: My wife and I I kicked off our honeymoon with this experience and it was a perfect start. We were running behind because our Uber cancelled and they were patient and didn’t leave without us, so very appreciated!
author: k_d

title: Wonderful evening
text: We went with friends on the last evening of our trip ,  crew were fantastic & the saxophonist was brilliant and set the mood for the trip , it was a really lovely evening , would do this trip again
author: gilliansmith23

title: Unforgettable Experience in Barcelona!
text: This was a truly unforgettable experience and I would 100% recommend doing it! I am already looking forward to doing it again when I go back to Barcelona. My husband booked us the sailing experience with the saxophone players and tapas for the last night of our honeymoon. Our Skipper was fantastic, the views were incredible, the music was lovely and our cups stayed full!
author: racheldesimone7

title: Beautiful Experience
text: Absolutely amazing loved the food! Thx was super cool to hear on the water. The Chef is  the best. Great views!
